pages.text: Build the Four-Pillar Shrine: an $(item)Aerie Core$() on an $(item)Aerie Plinth$() in the middle, and a pillar of Plinth, $(item)Aerie Column$() and $(item)Aerie Focus$() on each corner of a 5x5 square.$(br2)The other blocks inside the square are free: decorate as you like.

pages.name: Four-Pillar Shrine
pages.text: Right-click the Core to claim it. Once complete it attunes for about five minutes, then its owner can fly anywhere in the Core's chunk.
